Vuttodaya
one of the texts ment. in a. inscription a. Pagan, dated 1442 A. D.
See Pali tracts in inscriptions in the J. Myth. Soc. XXII, p. 413.
On Pāli prosody. in 6 chs. composed on the basis of Sanskrit works like Vṛttaratnākara etc. by Saṅgharakkhita Thera, said to be a disciple of Sāriputta an. Medhaṅkara of Ceylon, belongs to the 12th Cent. A. D.; agrees with work of Piṅgala.
See Ind. Cult. XV. p. 201.
Alwis p.. 186-88. Colombo p. 55-56 (a..). Colombo D.
